source: The `callCost` webhook in Telnyx's own published API description (github.com/team-telnyx/openapi, openapi/spec3.json, info.version 2.0.0, fetched 2026-10-11): schemas CallCost and CallCostPart, with the examples given there. Telnyx signs it like every other call-control webhook (Ed25519 over `<timestamp>|<body>`). The ids are the spec's examples; client_state is replaced by the test. Not yet checked against a live call (lesson L-016): replace this with a captured request from the first live Telnyx call.
